# Scale ai

Scale AI provides data labeling and annotation services for machine learning, offering access to a global workforce and sophisticated tools for training AI models with high-quality labeled data

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/scale-ai/.

## Actions

- **Add Task Tags**: Add tags to an existing task.
- **Create Batch**: Create a new batch within a project.
- **Create Document Transcription Task**: Create a document transcription task where workers transcribe and annotate information from single or multi-page documents.
- **Create Image Annotation Task**: Create an image annotation task where annotators label images with vector geometric shapes (box, polygon, line, point, cuboid, ellipse).
- **Create Lidar Annotation Task**: Create a lidar annotation task where annotators mark objects with 3D cuboids in 3D space.
- **Create LiDAR Segmentation Task**: Create a LiDAR segmentation task where annotators assign semantic class labels to individual LiDAR points.
- **Create Named Entity Recognition Task**: Create a named entity recognition task for labelers to highlight text entity mentions.
- **Create Segmentation Annotation Task**: Create a segmentation task where annotators classify pixels in an image according to provided labels.
- **Create Text Collection Task**: Create a textcollection task for collecting information from attachments and/or web sources.
- **Create Video Annotation Task**: Create a video annotation task where annotators draw geometric shapes around specified objects across video frames.
- **Create Video Playback Annotation Task**: Create a video playback annotation task where annotators draw shapes around specified objects in video files.
- **Get Batch** (read-only): Retrieve the details of a batch with the specified name.
- **Get Batch Status** (read-only): Retrieve the current status of a batch and task completion counts.
- **Get Project** (read-only): Retrieve details about a specific Scale AI project using its unique identifier.
- **Get Task** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific task in Scale AI.
- **Get Task by ID** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific task using its task ID.
- **Get Teams** (read-only): Retrieve basic information about all team members associated with the account.
- **List Batches** (read-only): Retrieve all batches in descending order by creation date.
- **List Projects** (read-only): Retrieve information for all projects in the Scale AI account with optional archived filtering.
- **List Tasks** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of tasks in descending order by creation time.
- **Update Task Unique ID**: Update or assign a unique identifier to a task.
- **Add Studio Assignments**: Add project assignments to team members in Scale AI Studio.
- **Delete Task Tags**: Remove specified tags from a Scale AI task.
- **Delete Task Unique ID**: Remove the unique identifier from a task.
- **Finalize Batch**: Finalize a batch so its tasks can be worked on.
- **Get Assets** (read-only): Retrieve file assets with filtering capabilities by project and metadata.
- **Get Fixless Audits** (read-only): Retrieve fixless audits by task ID or audit ID.
- **Get Quality Labelers** (read-only): Retrieve training attempts matching provided filter parameters.
- **Get Secure Task Response URL** (read-only): Retrieve secure authenticated task response data.
- **Get Studio Assignments** (read-only): Retrieve current project assignments of all active team users in Scale AI Studio.
- **Get Studio Batches** (read-only): Retrieve basic information about all pending batches in Studio.
- **Import File**: Import files from an external URL endpoint into Scale's system rather than uploading directly from local storage.
- **Invite Team Member**: Invite users by email to team with specified role.
- **Re-send Task Callback**: Re-send a callback for a completed or errored task to the callback_url.
- **Remove Studio Assignments**: Unassign projects from specified team members in Scale AI Studio.
- **Reset Batch Priorities**: Restore batch priority order to default order (calibration batches first, then sorted by creation date).
- **Set Batch Priorities**: Modify batch priority order in Scale AI Studio.
- **Set Project Ontology**: Set ontologies on a Scale AI project.
- **Set Project Parameters**: Set default parameters for tasks created under a project.
- **Set Task Metadata**: Set key-value metadata on an existing Scale AI task.
- **Upload File**: Upload a local file to Scale's servers with a maximum size limit of 80 MB per file.
